description: This file defines the ProductAttribute entity class, which models product attribute details within an e-commerce platform. It includes fields for price, weight, options, and various booleans indicating attribute characteristics, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ProductAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing a product attribute with pricing, weight, option references, and display properties, mapped to the PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTE table.

methods.name: getAttributePrice
methods.description: Getter for attributePrice, a utility string for submitting price input.

methods.name: getAttributeSortOrder
methods.description: Getter for attributeSortOrder, a utility string for submitting sort order.

methods.name: getAttributeAdditionalWeight
methods.description: Getter for attributeAdditionalWeight, a utility string for weight input.
